description: ATL, 2005 June regular phase: 52 of 52 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 52 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 52 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20180423170725: 52 listed, 52 matched to MLB's picks by name). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.

sources.notes: League-wide JSON, 1501 selections; sha256 188465d02300b092f4d534c5779d02c80ecf4f94b98348687d1d7f322a26886e. Supplies pick, round, franchise-stable team id, MLBAM person, school label. No signing data. Terms: individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use (research/history/sources.json).
